tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dragon_knight_breat: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
Knight Davion's breath has become that of the mighty Eldwurm Slyrak, remembered for burning numerous other knights to a crisp.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dragon_knight_drago: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.
Davion's combination of dragon talents and knightly skills makes him a vicious opponent in melee combat.

The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.

Regen and armor are increased by %regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%% during Elder Dragon Form.
Attacks are filled with lethal poison that affects enemy units and structures, reducing armor and dealing physical damage over time.
Attacks deal additional magic damage to enemy units. Spells and items have increased AoE.
Attacks are filled with frost that affects enemy units, slowing movement speed, attack speed, and reducing health restoration.
Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dragon_knight_wyrms: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.
Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dragon_knight_elder:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties. The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative.

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.
The dormant dragon power springs forth from within Davion, combining the powers of a legendary knight with a legendary Eldwurm.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dragon_knight_fireb: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.
Most Dragon Knights name no greater horror than the scourge of dragon's fire.
